about: Previous-release tests allowed to fail against the new source, because behaviour changed on purpose (workspace letter H6, rule 3; scripts/release/previous-tests.ts). Each entry: the test file and name, the version the change ships in, and why. A test failing that is not listed fails the release gate. Only the release just before is run, so an entry is dropped at the next release (2.1.0's four, for tail calls portable, are in git history at ec6dc1bba).

entries.name: gates a concrete (ref $T) on functionReferences
entries.reason: D2's type rule is wasm-tools' (owner, 2026-10-24: "wasm-tools' rule"; open-work 42): a concrete (ref $t) needs function references OR gc, so with gc still on, switching function references off no longer refuses it. The 2.2.0 test checks both: valid with only function references off, refused with both off.
